2608.01034.title: Opt.Gear Technical Report
2608.01034.paper_summary: We introduce Opt.Gear, a foundation model designed for efficient on-device deployment, real-tim inference, and strong task capability. It includes a dense model (1M, 270M, and 1B) with a context length of 64K. We designed a new hybrid architecture that combines a convolutional key-value gated mixer with local-global attention to reduce the KV-cache memory that tends to increase exponentially with long context. This architecture delivers up to X4.9 faster prefill and decoding speeds on the NPUs compared to models of a similar scale models. From a 2T tokens candidate corpus, Opt.Gear is trained on a curated 0.5T tokens subset without knowledge distillation. This is the most data-efficient of the existing foundation models. All models are released with open weights and deployment binaries for ONNX, Qualcomm NPU, and Apple ANE making Opt.Gear a practical base for edge applications that need fast, memory-efficient inference and strong task capabilities. Furthermore, to expand the ecosystem of on-device generative language models, we are introducing the Opt.Gear-1M that can be deployed on Micro-Controller Units (MCUs), a Tiny Language Model (TLM). Opt.Gear-1M is the first generative language model to achieve 20 TPS with W4A32 quantization on the ARM Cortex-M7 CPU of the STM32H747I-DISCO.
2608.01034.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹 Opt.Gear，一個設計用於高效於設備上部署、實時推理和強大任務能力的基礎模型。<lb/>它包括一個密集模型（1M、270M 和 1B），上下文長度為 64K。<lb/>我們設計了一種新的混合架構，將卷積鍵值門控混合器與局部-全局注意力相結合，以減少隨著長上下文而呈指數增長的 KV-cache 記憶體。<lb/>這種架構在 NPU 上提供了比類似規模模型快多達 X4.9 的預填充和解碼速度。<lb/>從 2T 令牌候選語料庫中，Opt.Gear 在經過策劃的 0.5T 令牌子集上進行訓練，且不使用知識蒸餾。<lb/>這是現有基礎模型中數據效率最高的模型。<lb/>所有模型均以開放權重和部署二進制文件的形式發布，支持 ONNX、Qualcomm NPU 和 Apple ANE，使 Opt.Gear 成為需要快速、內存高效推理和強大任務能力的邊緣應用的實用基礎。<lb/>此外，為了擴展設備上生成語言模型的生態系統，我們推出了 Opt.Gear-1M，該模型可以部署在微控制器單元（MCU）上，是一種微型語言模型（TLM）。<lb/>Opt.Gear-1M 是第一個在 STM32H747I-DISCO 的 ARM Cortex-M7 CPU 上以 W4A32 量化實現 20 TPS 的生成語言模型。
